title: Creative Designer

Details:
Responsibilities:

Design engaging social media creatives, marketing materials, and digital advertisements aligned with brand guidelines.
Create visually appealing designs for campaigns, banners, brochures, presentations, and promotional content.
Develop creatives for Instagram, YouTube, websites, and other digital platforms.
Edit short-form videos, reels, and promotional content for marketing campaigns.
Design motion graphics and animations to enhance brand storytelling.
Maintain consistency in brand identity, typography, colours, and visual aesthetics across all touchpoints.
Contribute creative ideas for campaigns, launches, and promotional activities.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Design, Fine Arts, Communication Design, or a related field (Freshers are welcome to apply).
